text.cs: Teck Castle was a ducal castle in the kingdom of Württemberg, immediately to the north of the Swabian Jura and south of the town of Kirchheim unter Teck. The castle took its name from the Teckberg ridge, 2,544 feet (775 m) high, which it crowned.
